name: Founden
description: Builds and deploys a running company from a plain-language prompt — website, user app with sign-in, and back office — through a documented 4-endpoint REST API that returns a live preview URL.

skills.name: Start Build
skills.description: Starts a build from a plain-language prompt via POST /v1/builds and returns an execution_id for the running job.

skills.name: Build Status
skills.description: Polls GET /v1/builds/{execution_id} for the current build status and the live preview URL once it is ready.

skills.name: Message Running Build
skills.description: Sends a follow-up instruction to a running build through POST /v1/builds/{execution_id}/message.

skills.name: Stop Build
skills.description: Stops a running build with POST /v1/builds/{execution_id}/stop, ending metered compute for that execution.
